headlines.description: William Osula and Harvey Barnes scored early in the second half at Selhurst Park as Newcastle dealt Crystal Palace a frustrating 2-0 Premier League defeat to pile more pressure on Pierre Sage.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palace's Sage under scrutiny as Newcastle win

headlines.description: Hull's unbeaten home record remains intact but the Tigers have not tasted victory for seven games after a 1-1 draw with Brentford at the MKM Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hull unbeaten run remains, Brentford snatch draw

headlines.description: Liverpool's expensively-assembled front four finally clicked into gear as they beat Brighton 2-0 to record their first home Premier League win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool see off Brighton 2-0 as Reds' attack clicks

headlines.description: The pressure on Michael Carrick grew as Manchester United slumped to a limp 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday.

headlines.description: Real Madrid cut the gap on LaLiga leaders Barcelona to three points after Kylian Mbappé struck a late winner in a 2-1 win at the Nou Camp on Sunday.
